title: The verb SER (to be)
summary: Use ser to identify people and things and to describe permanent or defining characteristics.

sections.heading: Forms of ser in the present
sections.body:
**Ser** is the main verb for identity: who someone is, what something is, origin, profession, nationality, and defining qualities. It is irregular and very common.

| Subject | ser | English |
|---|---|---|
| eu | **sou** | I am |
| você/ele/ela | **é** | you/he/she are/is |
| nós | **somos** | we are |
| vocês/eles/elas | **são** | you all/they are |

sections.heading: Identity, origin, and profession
sections.body: Use **ser** for facts that define someone or something. In Portuguese, professions normally do **not** use an article after ser unless they are modified.

examples.note: no article before a simple profession

sections.heading: Defining qualities
sections.body: Use **ser** for characteristics that feel inherent or stable: personality, material, ownership, time, and general descriptions.

keyPoints: Ser is irregular: sou, é, somos, são.
Use ser for identity, profession, origin, nationality, and defining traits.
Simple professions usually do not take um/uma after ser.
Days, dates, and clock time commonly use ser.

commonMistakes.note: Do not use an article with an unmodified profession.
